verdict.rationale: SerpApi outputs search results in open formats (JSON, HTML, Markdown) and offers a Searches Archive API to retrieve past results, which gives some data portability, but there is no evidence of a full account-level 'export everything and leave' feature — most cached data expires in 1h and ZeroTrace mode explicitly avoids storing anything at all. Missing for 10: comprehensive account/data export tooling, evidence of exporting historical usage/billing data, and any documented data-portability or account-closure workflow.
